name: Bread Panada
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the crumbs of stale white bread
ingredients.originalText: two tablespoonfuls of the crumbs of stale white bread

instructions.text: Put three gills of water and one tablespoonful of white sugar on the fire
Just before it boils add two tablespoonfuls of the crumbs of stale white bread, stir it well, and let it boil three or four minutes
Add one glass of white wine, a grated lemon and a little nutmeg
Let it boil up once, then remove it from the fire, and keep it closely covered until it is wanted for use

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put three gills of water and one tablespoonful of white sugar on the fire
2. Just before it boils add two tablespoonfuls of the crumbs of stale white bread, stir it well, and let it boil three or four minutes
3. Add one glass of white wine, a grated lemon and a little nutmeg
4. Let it boil up once, then remove it from the fire, and keep it closely covered until it is wanted for use
